summary: The original CI3 management UI reaches the first Models/default-inheritance wait after its reject-key and replacement-key path, then fails closed at the unchanged 30-second read. The same eight DOM booleans recur with the same relevant source bytes as the prior PR1219 failure. The current log cannot identify which full-view stage is pending or superseded, and the expired current artifact leaves original cleanup and final source/input evidence unknown. No functional repair or deadline change is justified.

checks.finding: The complete 133,008-byte retained log rehashes to the supplied SHA256 and Git blob. Its whole textual contents were read: early lines 1–1179 via a timestamp/ANSI-only presentation and original raw lines 1180–1397. No log lines were omitted.

The log names source 86f52244b5375834a4040cbc63803d68cc708087 and the linux-x64/opencode-v2-management lane. The checkout assertion and original input preparation use this exact head. No new source is being assessed as executed.
The original xvfb/node desktop-opencode-v2-management-smoke.ts command is retained complete. Its one invocation ends with exit 1; no retry or alternative flow appears in this job log.

The eight-file Node command reports 247 tests / 247 pass / zero failures, skips or cancellations; the separate dependency-install test reports 7/7. These preflight results do not qualify the later UI operation or substitute for its receipt.

The single TEST_V2_MANAGEMENT_MODELS_WAIT_FAILURE row has inheritanceCard false, modelsTabActive true, modelsTabDisabled false, refreshSpinner true, legacyModelsPanel true, projectContextSelector true, publicError false and publicWarning false.

The failed wait retains exactly 30,000 ms, strict post-await deadline rejection, original 100 ms cadence, owned-renderer assertion, and original non-context read-error identity. No additional click or timeout adjustment is supported.

The exact stack identifies modelsTab at UI138, called at UI219, then smoke102/168 and controls209. This is the first inheritance read, before selectProject('workspace'). It is not a later default-selection or reload failure.

By the unchanged sequential UI source, reaching line 219 follows reject-key and connect-key, their original command/finite-model assertions, auth-file checks, visible connection check, and model.assertPassive(2). This is control-flow evidence of reached checks; the current raw command/effect IDs and full receipt are unavailable.

checks.finding: Global-default, project-default, explicit project-test, later project-inheritance/clear/reload, and final five-intent UI qualification are downstream of the failed await and were not reached on this path. No model/default-test completion is claimed.

The panel supplies loadViewOnEnable:false; successful connection updates provider/directory state and skips a full-view refresh when viewRequestedRef is false. A connected card therefore does not prove that the complete Models view has already loaded.

checks.finding: The Models tab handler starts refresh only when no view and no loading are present. A tab can remain active while the existing original refresh is pending. The last DOM sample does not reveal which invocation owns loading.

The inheritance card requires a non-null view with configuredModels, projectPath, projectDefaultModel, allProjectsDefaultModel and defaultModelSource, plus stable bundled runtime >= 0.0.75. Current lock 0.0.160 passes the version condition. The missing card is not evidence that bundled runtime version is unsupported.

The LegacyConfiguredModelsPanel is the fallback whenever the support predicate is false, including an absent/pending full view. The Models refresh spinner is state.loading. These DOM booleans are compatible with a pending load and are not a direct view object, request-generation, or failure-stage observation.

The actual hook increments viewLoadRequestSeq, captures project context, suppresses stale responses, and clears loading only for the current request in finally. The accepted silent-load fix is already present. This log does not prove a new currentness/finally bug or identify a superseding request.

Captured loadView awaits capture, catalog, selectedPreferences and current-target validation before returning the full view. There is no stage-bearing successful/pending response in the log. Awaited capture/reconciliation, queued catalog/native work, preferences, and renderer settlement remain distinguishable source stages but unobserved current substages.

The fixture explicitly supplies private global/project preference roots for global, workspace and workspace-other descriptors. The current capture/preferences source identities are unchanged. A universally missing preference binding or changed default-scope schema is not established by this failure.
checks.evidence: management fixture52–81; prior capture/preferences trace, current exact identities

checks.finding: Coordinator catalog reads serialize per selected profile and preserve current target and absolute original deadline. Replacing a mismatched catalog owner requires confirmed close; failed reads retire only after cleanup. Removing, caching or bypassing these checks is not supported.

The fixture selects original timeoutMs 120000 / modelProbeTimeoutMs 120000. The original GUI card wait is 30000. This allows a still-pending metadata operation to coexist with GUI expiry, but the log does not measure the pending stage or prove completion after 30 s. It does not justify inflating either budget or weakening the predicate.

The host has an existing bounded metadata failure channel with stage/reason/elapsed/deadline/aborted, and read stages native-client, identity, plugins, permissions, MCP, credential, directory/activation, currentness, projection and dispose. It never warms metadata with a prompt. No corresponding current failure-stage observation appears in the retained job log.

The harness emits INCOMPLETE, throws the original inheritance timeout and exits1. The ordinary verifier then fails actual INCOMPLETE versus required PASS at its unchanged line 69 and exits1. Neither command converts this into partial PASS.

The uploader advertises 19 files, 847455 ZIP bytes and the stated archive digest for artifact14340275045. Root reports its URL expired before byte GET. No archive bytes, CRC, member census, receipt, app log, DOM or PNG from that artifact were read in this advisory.

The source finally attempts ordinary cleanup and writes the final summary, but status remains INCOMPLETE on both good and failed cleanup paths. The log has no current app exit/nativeRemaining/Host absence/group/source-after/input-after/model-server-close values. Generic runner orphan cleanup is not original custody proof.
